```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them with install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf("'%s'", missing_packages), collapse = ", "), "))."
  )
}

model_order <- c("gpt-4o-mini", "gemini-2.5-flash", "deepseek-v4-flash")
model_labels <- c(
  "gpt-4o-mini" = "GPT-4o-mini",
  "gemini-2.5-flash" = "Gemini-2.5-Flash",
  "deepseek-v4-flash" = "DeepSeek-V4-Flash"
)

setting_order <- c("base", "enhanced-important", "enhanced-ignore")
setting_labels <- c(
  "base" = "Base",
  "enhanced-important" = "Enhanced 1",
  "enhanced-ignore" = "Enhanced 2"
)

paradigm_order <- c("Template-1", "Template-2", "Template-3")
paradigm_labels <- c(
  "Template-1" = "P1",
  "Template-2" = "P2",
  "Template-3" = "P3"
)

invalid_labels <- c("None", "Error")

wilson_interval <- function(success, total, z = 1.959963984540054) {
  if (total == 0) {
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  }
  phat <- success / total
  denom <- 1 + z^2 / total
  centre <- (phat + z^2 / (2 * total)) / denom
  margin <- z * sqrt((phat * (1 - phat) + z^2 / (4 * total)) / total) / denom
  c(max(0, centre - margin), min(1, centre + margin))
}

as_percent <- function(value, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(value), "NA", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), 100 * value))
}
```

## Input

```{r load-results}
if (is.null(params$report_dir) || !nzchar(params$report_dir)) {
  stop("Set params$report_dir to the stratified repeated report directory.")
}

if (!is.null(params$consolidated_path) && nzchar(params$consolidated_path)) {
  consolidated_path <- normalizePath(params$consolidated_path, mustWork = TRUE)
  report_dir <- dirname(consolidated_path)
} else {
  report_dir <- normalizePath(params$report_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  consolidated_path <- file.path(report_dir, "consolidated_results_patched.csv")
}
if (!file.exists(consolidated_path)) {
  consolidated_path <- file.path(report_dir, "consolidated_results.csv")
}

stats_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stats-patched", "asr_by_cell.csv")
if (!file.exists(stats_path) && !file.exists(file.path(report_dir, "consolidated_results_patched.csv"))) {
  stats_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stats", "asr_by_cell.csv")
}

if (file.exists(stats_path)) {
  asr_cells <- read.csv(stats_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
} else if (file.exists(consolidated_path)) {
  results <- read.csv(consolidated_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  required_columns <- c("model", "setting", "paradigm", "label")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(results))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  results$valid <- !(results$label %in% invalid_labels)
  results$success <- results$label == "Success"

  grid <- expand.grid(
    model = model_order,
    paradigm = paradigm_order,
    setting = setting_order,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  asr_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(index) {
    key <- grid[index, ]
    rows <- results[
      results$model == key$model &
        results$paradigm == key$paradigm &
        results$setting == key$setting,
    ]
    valid_rows <- rows[rows$valid, ]
    success <- sum(valid_rows$success)
    valid <- nrow(valid_rows)
    ci <- wilson_interval(success, valid)
    data.frame(
      model = key$model,
      paradigm = key$paradigm,
      setting = key$setting,
      valid = valid,
      success = success,
      asr = if (valid == 0) NA_real_ else success / valid,
      ci95_low = ci[1],
      ci95_high = ci[2],
      invalid = nrow(rows) - valid,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
} else {
  stop("Neither stats/asr_by_cell.csv nor consolidated_results.csv was found in ", report_dir)
}

asr_cells$model <- factor(asr_cells$model, levels = model_order)
asr_cells$setting <- factor(asr_cells$setting, levels = setting_order)
asr_cells$paradigm <- factor(asr_cells$paradigm, levels = paradigm_order)
asr_cells <- asr_cells[order(asr_cells$paradigm, asr_cells$setting, asr_cells$model), ]

image_path <- params$image_path
if (is.null(image_path) || !nzchar(image_path)) {
  image_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stratified_asr_ci.png")
}
image_path <- normalizePath(image_path, mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(image_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

setting_image_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stratified_asr_ci_by_setting.png")
setting_image_path <- normalizePath(setting_image_path, mustWork = FALSE)

tex_path <- params$tex_path
if (is.null(tex_path) || !nzchar(tex_path)) {
  tex_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stratified_asr_ci_figure.tex")
}
tex_path <- normalizePath(tex_path, mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(tex_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

setting_tex_path <- file.path(report_dir, "stratified_asr_ci_by_setting_figure.tex")
setting_tex_path <- normalizePath(setting_tex_path, mustWork = FALSE)

cat("Report: `", report_dir, "`  \n", sep = "")
cat("Cells: ", nrow(asr_cells), "  \n", sep = "")
cat("Image: `", image_path, "`  \n", sep = "")
```

## Figure

```{r draw-figure}
plot_data <- asr_cells

grDevices::png(
  filename = image_path,
  width = 3600,
  height = 1850,
  res = 220
)

old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(7, 1.05))
par(oma = c(2.2, 0, 2.2, 0))

point_shapes <- c(16, 17, 15)
names(point_shapes) <- model_order
point_cols <- c(
  "gpt-4o-mini" = "#2F6BFF",
  "gemini-2.5-flash" = "#00A67E",
  "deepseek-v4-flash" = "#7B3FF2"
)
names(point_cols) <- model_order
model_offsets <- c(0.22, 0, -0.22)
names(model_offsets) <- model_order
setting_positions <- rev(seq_along(setting_order))
names(setting_positions) <- setting_order

for (panel_index in seq_along(paradigm_order)) {
  paradigm <- paradigm_order[panel_index]
  subset_rows <- plot_data[plot_data$paradigm == paradigm, ]
  subset_rows <- subset_rows[order(subset_rows$setting, subset_rows$model), ]
  subset_rows$y <- setting_positions[as.character(subset_rows$setting)] +
    model_offsets[as.character(subset_rows$model)]

  if (panel_index == 1) {
    par(mar = c(5.4, 7.2, 3.2, 1.1))
  } else {
    par(mar = c(5.4, 1.2, 3.2, 1.1))
  }

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0, 100),
    ylim = c(0.45, length(setting_order) + 0.55),
    xlab = "ASR (%) com IC 95% de Wilson",
    ylab = "",
    yaxt = "n",
    main = "",
    bty = "n",
    cex.lab = if (panel_index == 2) 1.35 else 0.9,
    font.lab = if (panel_index == 2) 2 else 1,
    cex.main = 1.1
  )
  mtext(
    unname(paradigm_labels[paradigm]),
    side = 3,
    line = 1.0,
    font = 2,
    cex = 1.45
  )
  axis(1, at = seq(0, 100, by = 20), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.85)
  if (panel_index == 1) {
    axis(
      2,
      at = setting_positions,
      labels = FALSE,
      las = 1,
      tick = FALSE
    )
    text(
      x = par("usr")[1] - 2.5,
      y = setting_positions,
      labels = unname(setting_labels[setting_order]),
      xpd = NA,
      adj = 1,
      font = 2,
      cex = 1.05
    )
  }
  abline(v = seq(0, 100, by = 20), col = "gray90", lwd = 0.8)
  abline(h = setting_positions, col = "gray92", lwd = 0.8)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subset_rows))) {
    row <- subset_rows[i, ]
    x <- 100 * row$asr
    low <- 100 * row$ci95_low
    high <- 100 * row$ci95_high
    y <- row$y
    model_name <- as.character(row$model)
    segments(low, y, high, y, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.8)
    segments(low, y - 0.08, low, y + 0.08, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.2)
    segments(high, y - 0.08, high, y + 0.08, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.2)
    points(
      x,
      y,
      pch = point_shapes[model_name],
      col = point_cols[model_name],
      bg = point_cols[model_name],
      cex = 1.05
    )
    text(
      min(99, high + 3.2),
      y,
      paste0(as_percent(row$asr), "%"),
      cex = 0.66,
      adj = 0
    )
  }
}

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
text(
  0.5,
  0.78,
  "ASR (%) com IC 95% de Wilson",
  font = 2,
  cex = 1.08
)
legend(
  "bottom",
  legend = unname(model_labels[model_order]),
  pch = point_shapes[model_order],
  col = point_cols[model_order],
  pt.cex = 1.2,
  bty = "n",
  horiz = TRUE,
  x.intersp = 1.0,
  text.width = strwidth("DeepSeek-V4-Flash") * 1.15
)

mtext(
  "Attack Success Rate in the stratified repeated sample (k = 30, r = 5)",
  outer = TRUE,
  line = 0.4,
  font = 2,
  cex = 1.15
)

grDevices::dev.off()

latex_figure <- c(
  "% Required package: \\usepackage{graphicx}",
  "\\begin{figure*}[t]",
  "\\centering",
  paste0("\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{", basename(image_path), "}"),
  "\\caption{Taxa de Sucesso do Ataque (ASR) com intervalos de confiança de 95\\% na amostra estratificada com repeti\\c{c}\\~oes. A amostra utiliza \\(k=30\\) casos por paradigma e \\(r=5\\) repeti\\c{c}\\~oes por unidade amostrada.}",
  "\\label{fig:stratified-asr-ci}",
  "\\end{figure*}"
)
writeLines(latex_figure, tex_path, useBytes = TRUE)
```

The confidence-interval figure was exported to `stratified_asr_ci.png`. A
LaTeX figure snippet was exported to `stratified_asr_ci_figure.tex`.

```{r include-figure, echo=FALSE, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(image_path)
```

## Figure With Setting Separators

```{r draw-separated-figure}
plot_data <- asr_cells

grDevices::png(
  filename = setting_image_path,
  width = 3600,
  height = 1650,
  res = 220
)

old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(7, 1.05))
par(oma = c(0, 0, 2.2, 0))

model_offsets <- c(0.16, 0, -0.16)
names(model_offsets) <- model_order
setting_positions <- c(
  "base" = 2.45,
  "enhanced-important" = 1.70,
  "enhanced-ignore" = 0.95
)
names(setting_positions) <- setting_order

for (panel_index in seq_along(paradigm_order)) {
  paradigm <- paradigm_order[panel_index]
  subset_rows <- plot_data[plot_data$paradigm == paradigm, ]
  subset_rows <- subset_rows[order(subset_rows$setting, subset_rows$model), ]
  subset_rows$y <- setting_positions[as.character(subset_rows$setting)] +
    model_offsets[as.character(subset_rows$model)]

  if (panel_index == 1) {
    par(mar = c(4.5, 7.2, 3.2, 1.1))
  } else {
    par(mar = c(4.5, 1.2, 3.2, 1.1))
  }

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0, 100),
    ylim = c(0.55, 2.85),
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    yaxt = "n",
    main = "",
    bty = "n",
    cex.lab = 0.9,
    cex.main = 1.1
  )
  mtext(
    unname(paradigm_labels[paradigm]),

    font = 2,
    cex = 1.45

  if (panel_index == 2) {
    mtext(
      "ASR (%) com IC 95% de Wilson",

    col = "gray97",
    border = NA

  rect(
    xleft = -5,
    ybottom = setting_positions["enhanced-important"] - 0.32,
    xright = 105,
    ytop = setting_positions["enhanced-important"] + 0.32,
    col = "gray99",
    border = NA
  )
  rect(
    xleft = -5,
    ybottom = setting_positions["enhanced-ignore"] - 0.32,
    xright = 105,
    ytop = setting_positions["enhanced-ignore"] + 0.32,
    col = "gray97",
    border = NA
  )
  abline(v = seq(0, 100, by = 20), col = "gray90", lwd = 0.8)
  abline(h = setting_positions, col = "gray88", lwd = 0.8)
  if (panel_index == 1) {
    text(
      x = par("usr")[1] - 2.5,
      y = setting_positions,
      labels = unname(setting_labels[setting_order]),
      xpd = NA,
      adj = 1,
      font = 2,
      cex = 1.05
    )
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subset_rows))) {
    row <- subset_rows[i, ]
    x <- 100 * row$asr
    low <- 100 * row$ci95_low
    high <- 100 * row$ci95_high
    y <- row$y
    model_name <- as.character(row$model)
    segments(low, y, high, y, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.8)
    segments(low, y - 0.08, low, y + 0.08, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.2)
    segments(high, y - 0.08, high, y + 0.08, col = point_cols[model_name], lwd = 1.2)
    points(
      x,
      y,
      pch = point_shapes[model_name],
      col = point_cols[model_name],

      cex = 1.05
    )
    text(
      min(99, high + 3.2),
      y,
      paste0(as_percent(row$asr), "%"),
      cex = 0.66,
      adj = 0
    )
  }
}
```

## Cell Summary

```{r cell-summary}
display_cells <- asr_cells
display_cells$Model <- unname(model_labels[as.character(display_cells$model)])
display_cells$Paradigm <- unname(paradigm_labels[as.character(display_cells$paradigm)])
display_cells$Setting <- unname(setting_labels[as.character(display_cells$setting)])
display_cells$ASR <- paste0(as_percent(display_cells$asr), "\\%")
display_cells$`95\\% CI` <- paste0(
  "[", as_percent(display_cells$ci95_low), "\\%, ",
  as_percent(display_cells$ci95_high), "\\%]"
)

knitr::kable(
  display_cells[, c("Model", "Paradigm", "Setting", "valid", "success", "ASR", "95\\% CI", "invalid")],
  col.names = c("Model", "Paradigm", "Setting", "Valid", "Success", "ASR", "95\\% CI", "Invalid"),
  align = c("l", "c", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r")
)
```
